name: Gaming
overview: Scripture teaches that the pursuit of wealth or gain through vanity or chance, such as gaming or gambling, is ultimately futile and diminishes true value, as seen in Proverbs 13:11 and Ecclesiastes 5:10. Instead, God calls believers to commit their works to Him and labor diligently with purpose and integrity (Proverbs 16:3; Ecclesiastes 9:10). The casting of lots may appear random, but the sovereign Lord governs all outcomes (Proverbs 16:33), reminding us that no one can serve both God and the love of money (Matthew 6:24). Therefore, Christians are encouraged to seek God’s will and avoid the temptation to place trust in uncertain gain.
